title: Fix TileSet loading slowdown from repeated full sorts of ID lists

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Closes #123486

## Additional information

<!--
Provide additional information and explanation of your PR, including areas that you are uncertain of or require special attention from reviewers. For examples, please read our pull request guidelines: https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/development/contribution_rules.html#explain-your-contributions
-->
The ID/coordinate lists in TileSet need to stay sorted, but the previous approach appended to the end and re-sorted the entire list on every insertion.
For large tilesets this adds up fast.
Noticing that we already have `Vector<T>::ordered_insert`, we can simply adopt it to solve this problem, producing the same result as the original code while avoiding repeated full re-sorts.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e2b42469291c6889f93ad83debb5d24f607d26e3/core/templates/vector.h#L200-L203

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e2b42469291c6889f93ad83debb5d24f607d26e3/modules/tilemap/tile_set.cpp#L5008-L5017

Performance test (using the script from the issue):
```powershell
scons platform=windows target=editor dev_build=yes arch=x86_64
```
```powershell
#before
Godot Engine v4.8.dev.custom_build.e2b424692 (2026-09-21 15:02:04 UTC) - https://godotengine.org

  1000 tiles:    0.049 s
  2000 tiles:    0.201 s
  4000 tiles:    0.905 s
  8000 tiles:    3.805 s
 16000 tiles:   16.092 s
 32000 tiles:   75.122 s
#after
Godot Engine v4.8.dev.custom_build.a0d0d38b8 (2026-09-21 17:48:25 UTC) - https://godotengine.org

  1000 tiles:    0.006 s
  2000 tiles:    0.011 s
  4000 tiles:    0.023 s
  8000 tiles:    0.048 s
 16000 tiles:    0.102 s
 32000 tiles:    0.226 s
 ```
